requests.request: Score this candidate's take-home: PR is github.com/prismteam-ai/x-engagement/pull/12, hosted at https://xe-demo.vercel.app, Loom linked in the PR. Assignment went out Monday 9am.
Can you grade Maria's assignment for the Oracle Property Intelligence role? I need a hiring recommendation with a score out of 100.
Collections dashboard says 12% promise-to-pay rate, the vendor portal says 9% for the same week. Which is right and why do they differ?
Reconcile LiveVox talk-time metrics with our internal call events: they're off by about 8% every day.
Define who is eligible for the payfail SMS campaign and the handoff contract from Filter to the SMS runtime.
Compose audience, templates and provider sends into one deterministic daily email runtime with scoring and allocation.
Design a throttled, idempotent nightly job that pushes 3M records to a partner API that allows 50 rps, with a cost gate.
Lay out a monorepo for a landing site, an authenticated portal and an admin app sharing types, with tRPC on Lambda.
We need an OR-Tools model to assign 200 agents to shifts respecting licenses and max hours.
Show me the exact lexicon definition for the payment entity, with enums and relationships.
Model a domain for insurance claims with reusable core concepts and an extension for auto claims.
Is the Email Workflow at parity with the pinned SMS workflow? I need a certification verdict, read-only.
Run a focused diagnostic on just the email workflow's replay and observability controls versus SMS.
Add a 7-day variant of our existing contact_rate metric definition on the dev Model; the metric family already supports windows.
Install the new text_message metric definitions into soofi Persist's metrics catalog, backfill 30 days and activate them.
Onboard partner Acme's daily SFTP file drop into our existing Connect service and prove it on dev.
Set up a weekly report on the existing Report service counting payments by portfolio, with a $3 cost cap.
Configure the rules for campaign 'Q4-prelegal' on the existing Rule service so bankruptcy and C&D accounts are excluded.
On the deployed Schedule, define who we contact each day from the past-due-60 cohort with a 5-day cooldown.
Write an inference configuration that extracts action items from meeting transcripts in Persist and test it.
Compose a business outcome on System that runs Rule selection then Schedule whenever a CSV lands in our bucket.
Configure a Transform extraction that turns HOA fee strings like '$450 quarterly' into amount and frequency.
Upload our product source zip to the Build API, build it and verify the CDK cloud assembly provenance.
Create a Puller subscription so the dev environment picks up new Report releases automatically.
Register our new product in the Marketplace catalog and check whether it's ready to publish.
Create an environment plan for a new customer domain and get it to readiness.
Grant the finance team permission to view reports through Access, and give our runner a service identity.
Submit a Figma-to-React job for our new reports page frame on the existing Console and bind it to the Report API.
Publish the Report OpenAPI and a getting-started guide on the existing documentation portal.
Move our story-reviewer agent onto the existing Enact service and test a run.
Onboard a new customer identity in Account and issue them a key.
Model's metric compiler can't express rolling-window ratios. Add that metric family.
Persist's metric backfill endpoint times out on 90-day windows; fix the engine.
Connect's WAIT_FOR_WEBHOOK verb doesn't verify HMAC signatures. Add verification to the driver.
The Report refresh state machine double-appends to the ledger when a refresh is retried. Fix it.
Entity selection isn't populating campaign_id when runs start by campaign; fix the Rule engine.
Add mobile, tablet and desktop responsive tests to the components Console generates from Figma.
Add per-key ordered event triggers to the System framework.
Transform's structured extraction returns empty objects when the model output fails the JSON Schema; fix the engine.
Build accepts source zips with symlinks pointing outside the archive. Harden intake.
The Deploy Puller keeps polling every minute during Marketplace outages; add backoff.
Add a channel filter to Enact's list_agents MCP tool and the GET /agents route.
Add expiring grants to the Access service.
The developer portal needs a page type for MCP server references.
Our LiveVox call counts and the Persist call metrics disagree by about 5% a day. Reconcile the definitions.
Our short links count Slack link previews as clicks. Fix click detection.
Groom this into a WOW story with subtasks: customers want to see failed payments in their history.
Draft a pitch for Prism aimed at a regional mortgage servicer in our editorial voice.
Sync SMS templates from the operational DB into the templates inventory with review PRs.
Create on-brand graphics for the new pricing section of prismteam.ai.
